title: RTL Interface Domain Configuration
description: Describes clock domains, reset domains, and asynchronous interface inputs/outputs for an RTL module.

clock_domains.description: Mapping of clock domain names to their configuration.

additionalProperties.title: Clock Domain
additionalProperties.description: Definition of a synchronous clock domain.

input_name.description: Optional clock input port name in the RTL module interface. If omitted, the domain name is used.

polarity.description: Clock edge used by sequential logic in this domain.

inputs_outputs.description: List of module interface inputs/outputs belonging to this clock domain. Entries may be exact port names or wildcard groups such as 's_axis_*'.

anyOf.description: Wildcard prefix representing a group of ports.

resets.description: Mapping of reset domain names to their configuration.

additionalProperties.title: Reset Domain
additionalProperties.description: Definition of a reset interface signal.

signal_name.description: Optional reset input port name in the RTL module interface. If omitted, the reset domain name is used.

polarity.description: Reset polarity by level. 'positive' means active-high reset, 'negative' means active-low reset.

async_domain.description: List of module interface inputs/outputs that are asynchronous to all defined clock domains.

anyOf.description: Wildcard prefix representing a group of ports.
